outcome.Summary: Added api/handler.go with NewHandler(s *Store) http.Handler using Go 1.24 ServeMux path patterns: GET /healthz returns text "ok"; /notes supports POST (validates non-empty trimmed title, returns 201 + note JSON) and GET (JSON array in id order, [] when empty, case-insensitive ?q filter on title/body); /notes/{id} supports GET (404 missing, 400 non-integer id) and DELETE (204/404); all other methods on these paths return 405 with a JSON {"error": ...} body, and all JSON responses set Content-Type: application/json. Added api/handler_test.go with httptest-based tests covering every endpoint, error cases, ordering, filtering, and 405 handling. Verified with `go vet ./... && go test ./...` — all pass.
